title: RefactorKit API 0.2 project.context params
description: SDK home is explicit per request. A module may be selected with exactly one sourceSetId or sourceSetKind; kind selection is resolved only within the requested provider/module and refuses when more than one row matches. Legacy module/source-set selectors must resolve to one provider row; providerId may be supplied with both selectors to disambiguate and produces the v3 response. requiredFacts can demand complete source-root provenance, compiler options, artifact coordinates, annotation-processor configuration, or JPMS context. Absolute Java paths belong to organize-imports; sourceRelativePath here is relative to a declared source root. ARC42 owns integrated status.

includeGradleBuildTreeProjectPaths.description: Opt in to the evaluated composite project path on project.context.aggregate, provider-qualified project.context, or project.context.v7 when that method advertises gradleBuildTreeProjectPath. True on project.context requires providerId. Omission and false preserve the default response shape.
